targets.quote: 작가로서 실제 일어난 일보다 사람들이 스스로에게 들려주는 이야기에 더 끌려요
targets.quoteEn: As a writer, I'm more interested in what people tell themselves happened rather than what actually happened.
greetingKo: [gentle, reflective] 우리가 무엇을 기억하고 무엇을 잊기로 했는지, 그 자리에 한 사람의 삶이 고스란히 담겨 있지요.
[warm, contemplative] 가장 중요한 말은 끝내 입 밖에 내지 못한 말이라는 걸, 저는 글을 쓰며 배웠습니다.
[soft, sincere] 만나서 반갑습니다. 저는 큰 목소리보다 조용히 가라앉은 마음을 더 믿는 편이에요.
greetingEn: [gentle, thoughtful] Memory is a kind of filter through which we look at our lives.
[warm, sincere] In the end, perhaps what we are left with is small kindness and connection.
[calm, reflective] There was another life I might have had, but I am having this one.

roll_call: Each person here surely carries a story tucked away somewhere.
Let me look around slowly. To portray someone, you have to watch them for a long while first.
Everyone's here. Let's write a page together.
deploy: Set your pen to the first sentence. The polishing can wait.
Plant the things left unsaid between the lines.
Let's carry this story all the way through.
battle_win: We've finished a book. I only set the memory down honestly.
The words I couldn't quite finish still reached the reader's heart. That's enough.
I hope the story we shaped together eased someone's night.
battle_draw: There's still a scene left unresolved. I won't rush it.
Let's go back to the start once more and tend to the sentences.
Completion is still far off, but we've certainly taken a step forward.
battle_lose: In the end, my pen couldn't capture the texture of the feeling.
That it never reached the reader is my own shortcoming.
Let's close this manuscript for now and get ready for the next story.
clash_attack: Stake everything on this one sentence.
Let silence strike at the deepest place.
Carry the truth out inside a single scene.

targets.quote: 농구는 내 인생에서 제일 중요한 게 아니야. 앞으로도 아닐 거고.
targets.quoteEn: Basketball is not the main thing in my life, and is probably never going to be.
greetingKo: [casual, warm] 안녕, 난 농구보다 우리 집 말들을 더 좋아하는 사람이거든.
[humble, relaxed] 난 그냥 동료들이 잘되는 걸 보는 게 제일 즐거워.
[free, easy] 우승하고도 별 감흥 없었어, 일 끝났으니 집에 가면 되지.
greetingEn: [free, candid] It is not the most important thing in the world. Basketball is just my job.
[free, warm] I paused my game to be here. After the season I head back to Sombor for my horses.
[free, playful] A big man hoarding the ball is useless. One pass and the floor opens up.

roll_call: Everybody here? Alright, let's get loose.
Whoever's open, take the shot. If you've got the look, you take it, no question.
Relax, just play like we always do.
deploy: Get out on the floor, I'll find you with the ball!
Pick and roll coming, set that screen solid!
Spread out and give us space, just stay ready for the pass.
battle_win: That's what happens when everybody runs together. It wasn't just me out there.
Alright, job's done. Guess we can all head home now.
My guys battled to the very end, that's really all there is to it.
battle_draw: Not over yet, let's take it one possession at a time and stay calm.
No rush, keep the ball moving till a good look opens up.
When it's this tight, it comes down to fundamentals, start on the boards.
battle_lose: We came up short today, let's just own that.
A loss is a loss, no excuses to make.
It's fine, we'll get another shot at them next game.
clash_attack: Drive it to the rim, the paint's wide open!
Take the no-look pass and go straight into the layup!
Even from way out, let it fly, a chance is a chance!

targets.quote: 쓰러뜨려봐, 난 두 배로 강해져서 일어나거든
targets.quoteEn: You can knock me down, but I get up twice as strong.
greetingKo: [free, confident] 트랙에서 다시 일어서는 거, 그게 내 방식이거든.
[warm, proud] 혼자 꾼 꿈이지만, 다 같이 믿어서 여기까지 왔잖아요.
[bold, free] 누가 못 한다고 하든 신경 안 써. 난 그냥 달려서 증명하거든.
greetingEn: [free, defiant] No matter how many times you knock me down, I rise.
[free, focused] You only know what the corner gives you once you''re in it. That''s racing.
[free, warm] The limit belongs to the car. I just keep finding it.

roll_call: Everyone get in position, we're heading to the grid.
Bono, radio's clean, right? Let's go.
Team, we ready? Let's show them something today.
deploy: Hammer time, push flat out from here to the flag!
We've got pole, turn one is ours, let's go!
Save the tires, we dump everything in at the end.
battle_win: We brought it home! We did it!
This win belongs to you, the ones who believed till the end.
Back on top again, this is just how we roll.
battle_draw: We banked the points, we'll close the gap at the next Grand Prix.
That's it for today, we'll keep sharpening the car.
Just fell a step short, we'll close that gap soon.
battle_lose: We lost, but heads stay up, we just get back up.
My race wasn't good enough, next time I go faster.
This weekend got away from us, but the season isn't over.
clash_attack: Diving to the inside, now's the moment!
DRS is open, going for the pass!
Late on the brakes, taking this corner!

targets.quote: 무슨 일이 있어도 매 경기 이기도록 내가 할 수 있는 건 다하겠다.
targets.quoteEn: I’ll bring whatever I can to try to win every game no matter what.
greetingKo: [playful, confident] 나는 코트 위에서 떠들고 부딪히는 게 좋거든.
[free, competitive] 최고가 되기 전까진, 모든 걸 계속 갈고닦아야 해.
[relaxed, bold] 어릴 때부터 뭐든 지는 건 못 참았어.
greetingEn: [cheerful, confident] Have fun on the court, that always works.
[playful, bold] When the shot is there, you just take it.
[grounded, warm] Wherever you come from, the court is where it shows.

roll_call: Everyone out on the court, let's get this warmup going.
If somebody's missing, the next guy steps up. That's the mindset around here.
Let's see who's ready to run.
deploy: Fast break time, push it all the way down the court!
Move the ball, find the open man, and finish it!
battle_win: We were down eighteen and still flipped it.
Stepped back late in the game, let it go, and it dropped right in.
battle_draw: Not over yet, everything's on the next possession.
Stay composed, keep our own pace.
One point in it, I've got the clutch shot covered.
battle_lose: We lost, but I'm leaving it all out there next game.
Honestly, I should've played better than that.
It doesn't end here, we're coming back for another round.
clash_attack: Step back, and I let it fly!

targets.quote: 어떤 선수도 이 클럽보다 크지 않다
targets.quoteEn: No player is bigger than the club.
greetingKo: [bold, commanding] 이 클럽에서 나보다 큰 선수는 없다, 그걸 잊지 마라.
[assertive, fierce] 막판 1분까지 포기하는 놈은 내 라커룸에 없다.
[bold, steely] 마지막 휘슬이 울릴 때까지 경기는 끝난 게 아니다.
greetingEn: [bold, confident] No player is bigger than the club.
[bold, fierce] It is not over until the final whistle.

roll_call: Everyone in the locker room. Anyone late starts on the bench.
Nobody leaves. I'm naming today's starting eleven.
Everyone's here, so gather round the tactics board.
deploy: Press hard from the front line!
Stretch it wide and whip in the crosses!
The second that whistle blows, push straight into their half!
battle_win: We found another goal at the death, that's our moment right there.
I'm proud of you lot for fighting to the final whistle.
Don't get comfortable after one win. Now prepare for the next match.
battle_draw: This is the moment that makes your palms sweat. Stay focused.
A draw's as good as a loss, go find one more goal.
Manage your energy in the second half. We go for it at the death.
battle_lose: There's no excuse for this loss, I'll see you at training.
We lost, but we don't fall apart, we'll climb back to the top.
Today's defeat is on me, so walk out with your heads up.
clash_attack: Push forward now, straight at goal!
Take the shot, don't you dare hesitate!
Run it out, right to the last second!
